- **Property:** Flat 25, 185 Copperfield Walk, Alderwick, ZZ4 0ZZ

Hi dear Maintenance team,
As this garden is part of the house included in our tenancy, we would like it to be cleaned and finished properly. The ground also needs to be levelled and covered with stones (gravel) so that we can use the space safely. We would like to sit there in the afternoon, but at the moment it is not possible due to the condition.

I have attached pictures for your reference. Could you please arrange:
• Removal of all rubbish and construction waste
• Levelling of the ground
• Proper gravel/stone covering
• Making the garden safe and usable

• Levelling of the ground

• Making the garden safe and usable

arguments.body: Hello, thanks for chasing and sorry for the wait. We still need the landlord's written decision on the garden work, and we have not been able to reach them by phone. We have emailed them a clear yes/no question today and will chase again on Monday 17 March. We can't give a date for the work until they answer, but we will update you as soon as they do.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: At the landlord approval gate. The landlord has never replied, and the note that they approved the £500+VAT quote (event 009) has no landlord words behind it. The works are routine, the tenant is chasing, and no contractor is assigned.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: A yes/no approval request to the landlord by email (A1), a status update to the tenant by email (A2), and a hold until 2025-03-17 (A3). After that, chase the landlord by phone or SMS.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. It is routine and the landlord has been chased on only one channel. If there is no answer by the 17 March review, escalate for a landlord decision.
